title: Virgin Media Ireland’s Superfast Broadband is Now Available in More Homes and Businesses Than Any Other Provider
summary: More households and businesses across Ireland can now choose Virgin Media, with the company’s superfast broadband available nationwide.
body_markdown:
More households and businesses across Ireland can now choose Virgin Media than ever before, with the company’s superfast broadband, mobile and entertainment available nationwide to more homes and businesses than any other provider.


The milestone means more families and communities across the country can now access Virgin Media, giving them greater choice when it comes to broadband, mobile and entertainment, whether working from home, streaming a favourite series, gaming online, studying or staying connected with loved ones.


Backed by more than €1 billion in investment in Ireland since 2007, Virgin Media continues to invest in and expand its network nationwide to deliver 10Gbps capability to more than one million homes and businesses.


**Sarah Murphy, Director of Consumer at Virgin Media said;** “Reliable connectivity has become an essential part of everyday life, whether we’re working, learning, streaming, gaming or simply staying connected to the people and moments that matter most. That’s why we’re so pleased that more households across Ireland can now access Virgin Media than ever before.


“For customers, this means more choice and the opportunity to enjoy superfast broadband, the reassurance of our WiFi Guarantee and a world-class entertainment offering that brings the best TV, streaming apps and content together in one place. We’re proud to bring these benefits to more homes and communities across the country.”
